rawSnapshotsOnly.reason: Kick raw snapshots retain exact observation-time category membership for only 60 days, shorter than the required 180-day current-plus-previous History window.

existingDailyRollups.reason: daily_rollups do not preserve category identity or category-specific streamer contributions.

existingEmbeddedHourlyCategory.reason: The accepted embedded-hourly model preserves bounded hourly dominant-category evidence, not every exact category contribution needed for filter-before-ranking History.

unboundedStreamerCategoryRows.reason: Retaining every potential pair without a hard fail-closed bound is incompatible with the existing Free Strong storage model.

preRankedOrTopKPerCategory.reason: Any per-day Top K truncation can remove a streamer that becomes a period Top streamer after aggregating an arbitrary selected range.

history_category_daily.purpose: Exact selected-category day totals and concurrent category peak. peak_viewers is the maximum sum of viewers in that category at one observed snapshot, never a sum of per-streamer peaks.

history_category_streamer_daily.purpose: All retained contributors for a complete day so period ranking is computed after category selection. No Top K is stored.

history_category_day_status.purpose: Fail-closed day authority and category coverage.

hardDailyCaps.reason: A hard capacity cap is allowed only as a fail-closed availability boundary. It must never selectively truncate category or streamer contributions.

generationSemantics.input: category-source-v1 minute_snapshots while the complete day is still inside 60-day raw retention
generationSemantics.categoryViewerMinutes: sum category viewers at each retained snapshot multiplied by the accepted five-minute History rollup weight
generationSemantics.categoryPeakViewers: maximum concurrent selected-category viewer sum across retained snapshots
generationSemantics.streamerViewerMinutes: sum streamer viewers for snapshots where that streamer has the selected provider-scoped category
generationSemantics.streamerPeakViewers: maximum streamer viewers while in the selected category
generationSemantics.ranking: query category first, aggregate all complete retained contributor rows across the selected period, then rank/cap
generationSemantics.coverage: if category metadata is missing, source coverage is partial, generation is incomplete, or a daily hard cap is exceeded, persist status and fail closed rather than inventing zero-valued contributions
generationSemantics.rerun: same-day regeneration must be idempotent; if a later rerun discovers overflow, previously generated category and contributor rows for that day must be removed before status becomes unavailable_overflow

capacityProof.method: Use the already accepted 12A-4 separate-hourly SQLite benchmark as a conservative row-size proxy because that row shape includes provider/day/streamer/category text, metrics, contract metadata, a primary key, and a category/day index. The proxy already includes the accepted 20 percent safety margin.
capacityProof.note: The 60 MB design budget is a hard later implementation gate, not permission to consume the full reserve. A later local benchmark and production cost probe must remain at or below it.

sharedSchemaAssessment.reason: The logical keys and fail-closed coverage model are provider-independent, but Twitch has a different snapshot cap, raw retention, storage baseline, and capacity budget and therefore requires its own later decision.

requiredLaterGates: Repository-only migration candidate for the three bounded tables and provider/category/day indexes; no remote apply.
Deterministic local SQLite benchmark proving the exact selected schema stays at or below the 60 MB incremental design budget with the daily fail-closed caps.
Controlled production schema-apply gate with preservation and idempotency evidence.
Bounded generator package that reuses existing maintenance scheduling, proves exact category concurrent peaks and filter-before-ranking contributions, and writes status before exposing data.
Production execution-cost probe and storage remeasurement before generator enablement.
Forward-only accumulation evidence long enough to demonstrate useful observed coverage and the daily overflow rate without backfill.
Hidden Kick History category API/UI candidate with mixed raw/aggregate boundary tests and no unfiltered History regression.
Separate public-cutover decision and exact-production acceptance.
nextGate: Create a repository-only migration and deterministic benchmark package for the bounded exact Kick History category aggregate. Do not apply it remotely or change runtime in that gate.
